# laravelforge_server_php_max_execution_time (Resource)

Manages the PHP `max_execution_time` setting on a Laravel Forge server. This is a singleton per server: it has no own ID, cannot be destroyed (delete is a no-op), and apply just PUTs the desired value.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_execution_time` (Number) PHP `max_execution_time` in seconds.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose PHP max execution time is managed.
